# Two sitemaps on purpose. Crawlers read robots.txt only from the origin root, so
# the copy inside /MealUnits/ is never fetched - this is MealUnits' only crawl
# entry, and losing this line is silent search death for a site that looks fine.
#
# The old file was generated by gatsby-plugin-robots-txt and existed on no branch.
# This one is a real file, which is the whole point.

Sitemap: https://MominBinShahid.github.io/MealUnits/sitemap.xml
